verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core architecture is built around multi-agent orchestration: Crews (collaborative groups of agents), Tasks with sequential/hierarchical process execution, delegation tools for agent-to-agent handoff, and Flows for event-driven coordination of multiple tasks/crews. GitHub description explicitly confirms 'autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on case studies demonstrating complex multi-crew/flow orchestration at scale beyond vendor docs.
